column1: has been issued in terms of the preceding provisions of this

column3: Any  regulation  may  be  made  for  the  purposes  of

column1: this Part of this Act to be applicable to offshore companies

column3: An offshore company registered under this Part of

column1: this  Act  may  carry  on  business  as  authorised  by  the
Commission only in and from the area of Authority of the

column3: An offshore company which intends to continue its

column1: business as an offshore company in terms of this Act shall,
at the commencement of that year and no later than the thirty-
first day of January of every succeeding year, produce in the
manner  specified,  to  the  Registrar-General  of  Companies
proof of payment of the annual fee, in such amount as shall
be determined by the Commission.

column3: An offshore company so registered may notify the

column1: Commission of its intention to cease carrying on business as
an offshore company in and from the Area of Authority of
the Colombo Port City, by giving notice in writing to the
Commission. The Commission shall, with the concurrence
of the Registrar-General of Companies, take such steps as
may be required.
